summary: Block 8: the EXACT integration patch is prepared under encoding-core/integration/, shared originals untouched. Two unified diffs, plus patched copies for reading; both apply cleanly (patch -p1 --dry-run rc 0 on frozen copies). 0001 inserts EncodingApproximationAt and uniform_precision_contradiction (full transplanted body) before the old def, turns FiniteEncodingApproximationAt into an abbrev alias with identical binders, and replaces the 153-line body by a two-line call; 0002 does the same for AmbientEncodingAt and the ambient theorem. No import is added, so no wrapper can be proved by importing a theorem of its name, and the review-only _core copies are excluded. Statement delta is EMPTY for both public theorems (identical statement sha). Measured net line change -126 (Spectrum +33, Limits -159; earlier ~150 projection superseded). Both Circle local-instance pairs precede both edit sites, so no instance is added. Two narrow smoke roots plus axioms/check lines for both roots, the successor theorem and the deep consumer. Input hashes frozen. UNCOMPILED: the saving is not verified.
